sn11.23:1.3: “Bhikkhus, once in the past Vepacitti, lord of the asuras, was sick, afflicted, gravely ill.
sn11.23:1.4: Then Sakka, lord of the devas, approached Vepacitti to inquire about his illness.
sn11.23:1.5: Vepacitti saw Sakka coming in the distance and said to him:
sn11.23:1.9: ‘I won’t teach it, dear sir, until I have asked the asuras for permission.’
sn11.23:1.10: “Then, bhikkhus, Vepacitti, lord of the asuras, asked the asuras:
sn11.23:1.11: ‘May I teach the Sambari magic to Sakka, lord of the devas?’—‘Do not teach him the Sambari magic, dear sir.’
sn11.23:1.13: “Then, bhikkhus, Vepacitti, lord of the asuras, addressed Sakka, lord of the devas, in verse:
